jobs.description_text:
Who we are

 

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

The firm trades over $250bn a day across 35 countries and has over 300 employees based in London, Singapore, New York, Paris, Bristol, Mumbai, Yerevan and Kajaani.

 

We leverage the talent of the people who work here, modern computational techniques and state-of-the-art research infrastructure to analyse large data sets across markets quickly and efficiently, to maximize the effectiveness of our proprietary trading algorithms. We are actively seeking new methods and ideas. The models that drive our trading strategies have evolved considerably over the last 10 years, from econometric methods that gave our company its name, to trees, to neural networks, to modern deep learning architectures.

 

XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing over 25,000 GPUs with 1 exabyte of usable storage. Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science

Position Objective & Summary

jobs.title: Customer  Success  Associate
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Customer Success Associate to join our team in Toronto! As a Customer Success Associate you will be responsible for driving strategy for the Achievers recognition and engagement platform while continuously driving value for our customers. You will play a key role with our customers by promoting product adoption and expansion, highlighting best practices and implementing recognition strategies. If you are passionate about customer success, have a knack for sales and a flare for technology you’ll fit right in!

jobs.title: Customer Support Advisor
jobs.description_text: A Customer Support Advisor is a highly skilled, customer-focused professional responsible for delivering exceptional support to both program administrators (clients) and members. This role primarily supports program administrators (CSS function) while also contributing to Member Support to ensure seamless end-to-end service. In this role, you will own a diverse portfolio of support cases, including complex and escalated issues. You bring a strong understanding of the platform, apply advanced problem-solving skills, and collaborate cross-functionally to drive timely and effective resolutions. You are viewed as a trusted resource within the team and contribute to elevating overall support quality.

jobs.title: Customer Value & Growth Program Manager
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Customer Value & Growth Program Manager to own and drive the company-wide program that ensures our customers realize the value of their investment with Achievers and incrementally grow their spend with us as a result. Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Marketplace, Enablement, Revenue Operations and Finance each own a piece of this today. You will sit at the centre, pulling those pieces into one integrated strategy, guiding and collaborating with each team as they build their part, and making sure everything we do aligns to a consistent vision. You are accountable for making sure the right plans exist, that they connect, and that the functions who deliver them are set up to execute. Your impact comes from how well you align, equip and drive the people closest to our customers. The role goes beyond program management. We are looking for someone who brings a commercial point of view, challenges the plans on the table, contributes to the thinking, and acts as a genuine partner to every function involved.

jobs.title: Finance Manager, Marketplace ⭐
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a highly motivated and analytical SFA/Manager to take full ownership of our global e-commerce Marketplace P&L, one of Achievers' most important revenue streams. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Business Intelligence, Customer Success, Merchandising, and Product, translating Marketplace activity into financial insight, strategic forecasting, and operational action. You won't just report the numbers - you'll explain what happened, forecast what comes next, and actively shape the strategy and direction to help support growth. From building predictive models and share-of-wallet analyses to partnering with Customer Success on NRR strategy and existing customer ARR forecasting, this is a role for someone who wants to make a measurable impact across the business. If you bring experience from e-commerce, retail, or a rewards/marketplace environment, that's a significant advantage, you'll hit the ground running with an intuitive understanding of redemption and e-commerce dynamics, catalogue economics, and customer purchasing behavior that are central to this role.

jobs.title: Global Payroll and Benefits Administrator
jobs.description_text: Achievers is hiring a Global Payroll and Benefits Administrator on an 18-month contract to provide maternity leave coverage to run Canadian and US payroll and own benefits administration for both countries. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Global Payroll & Benefits, you will process bi-weekly payrolls in Workday (Canada) and ADP Workforce Now (US), manage remittances, year-end, payroll/benefits journal entries and back up global payroll delivery through Remote.

jobs.title: Manager, Performance Intelligence
jobs.description_text: The Marketplace is the rewards shopping experience within the Achievers platform. Its performance is shaped by a connected set of drivers, including member access, traffic, utilization, conversion, redemption, catalogue relevance, vendor performance, fulfilment reliability and the economics of each transaction. As Manager, Marketplace Performance Intelligence, you will give Marketplace one clear view of performance and turn intelligence into coordinated action. You will lead Marketplace operational analytics and identify opportunities to improve performance and scalability, own the analytics roadmap and recurring performance routines, and shape executive narratives/decisions. You will work in close partnership with the Finance Manager, Marketplace through a formal dotted-line relationship, connecting FP&A’s official financial outlook and governance with deeper customer, member and operational evidence. This role is also expected to structure and execute complex analyses that are cross-functional, commercially material, ambiguous or executive-facing. Success requires strong analytical judgement, commercial curiosity and executive communication. You will work across Marketplace, FP&A, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Product Marketing, BI, Product Analytics, ProDev and Support to strengthen the analytical foundation, clarify ownership and translate findings into measurable action.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive
jobs.description_text: About Achievers Achievers offers more than just a thank you program. Our employee recognition and rewards software inspires employees to recognize everyone, every day, everywhere. With 4.3 million global users, we empower employees across 190 countries. Visit us at achievers.com to learn more and check out our platform in action. Join our team of A-players who bring passion to our purpose and believe that meaningful change creates extraordinary outcomes — together, we’ll inspire recognition everywhere and achieve results that matter. Our commitment to you: At Achievers, we hire you for you because we value the unique perspective and individuality that each person brings to our team. We are committed to creating an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace where you belong, and your contributions are celebrated. Together, we achieve more by combining our unique strengths, fostering collaboration, and inspiring each other to reach new heights. The Opportunity: We’re looking for a Mid-Market Account Executive to join our growing sales team in Sydney! In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to drive meaningful impact by helping mid-sized businesses achieve their goals through our solutions. You’ll take ownership of identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and driving revenue growth within the mid-market segment.

jobs.title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner
jobs.description_text: As a Senior HR Business Partner, you will serve as a strategic advisor to leaders, helping them build high-performing teams, make informed workforce decisions, and drive organizational effectiveness. You will leverage business insight, workforce data, and talent expertise to influence decisions, strengthen leadership capability, and improve business outcomes. This role operates with significant autonomy and partners with leaders across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Enablement Manager
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Technical Enablement Manager, you will design and scale enablement programs that elevate technical capability across our solutions consultants, sales, and post-sales teams. You'll build on-ramp and continuous learning experiences, create technical playbooks and certifications, and partner with Product, Engineering, and GTM to ensure field teams can confidently position, design, and deliver Achievers solutions to both mid-market and enterprise customers. This role is critical to field productivity, ramp velocity, and our ability to win in a competitive market.

jobs.title: Strategic Alliance Director
jobs.description_text: Actian is the leader in hybrid data management, cloud data warehouse, and data integration technology. We're experiencing exponential growth and expanding our go-to-market engine through strategic partnerships. We're seeking a Strategic Alliance Director to build and scale 6-8 NA consulting/SI partners as a primary revenue engine. Own the end-to-end partner lifecycle: selection, onboarding, GTM strategy, enablement, and revenue delivery. You'll be measured on partner-sourced customer opportunities and deal closure. Reports to: Global Head of Partnerships | Works with: NA Sales Leader and regional reps across all NA sales regions Compensation & Accountability 70% of annual quota is based on partner-sourced opportunities delivered to Actian sales. This is a revenue-accountable role where success is measured by the volume, quality, and closing rate of customer opportunities your partner relationships generate for the field sales team. The remaining 30% focuses on partner enablement, solution co-creation, GTM strategy, and ecosystem management.

jobs.title: Accountant / Senior Accountant - US Accounting
jobs.description_text: Acceldata is reimagining the way companies observe their Data! Acceldata is the pioneer and leader in data observability, revolutionizing how enterprises manage and observe data by offering comprehensive insights into various key aspects of data, data pipelines and data infrastructure across various environments. Our platform empowers data teams to manage products effectively by ensuring data quality, preventing failures, and controlling costs.

jobs.title: Manager, Global Practice and Delivery (Solutions & Services)
jobs.description_text: We're looking for a Manager, Global Practice and Delivery to build, lead, and scale a global team of Solutions Consultants and Forward-Deployed Engineers responsible for enterprise implementations, technical consulting, SaaS deployments, and platform migrations. You'll lead our North American services organization while helping shape global delivery practices that enable customers to successfully deploy, adopt, and realize measurable value from Acceldata's data management and observability solutions. You'll build a scalable services delivery engine, ensuring customer engagements are delivered on time, within budget, to high-quality standards, and consistently across multiple customers. You should be equally comfortable discussing data architecture trade-offs with a customer's technical team and coaching Solutions Consultant Or/And , Forward-Deployed Engineers on delivering complex on-premises and SaaS solutions. We're looking for a forward-thinking leader who combines deep technical delivery expertise with ownership of practice strategy, commercial growth, operational excellence, and organizational capability building.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Partner Marketing
jobs.description_text: Senior Manager, Partner Marketing You drive the marketing relationship with Acceldata’s technology/ISV and channel partners and turn it into joint demand, awareness, and enablement. Leverage the doors opened by the Partnership team to build a strong relationship with the partner’s marketing organization. You find the joint events, the co-sponsorships, the campaigns, and you deploy the budget to make them happen while keeping the Partnership team appraised of the actions. The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualised factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills and experience. In addition to the salary range listed above, total compensation also includes equity and performance-related bonus(es) for eligible employees. This role is at-will and Acceldata reserves the right to modify base pay and other compensation components at any time based on individual performance, team or company results, or market conditions.

jobs.description_text:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.  

We’re here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

This role will inflect and implement Aledade’s programs and technologies and learn what really “moves the needle” in terms of delivering quality health outcomes while reducing overall cost for the assigned ACOs. This role requires demonstrated excellence in creating buy-in with internal and external stakeholders to promote and affect change in the way healthcare is delivered.

jobs.title: People & Workplace Operations Associate
jobs.description_text: About AllTrails AllTrails is the app for exploring the outdoors. We help people spend more time outside by connecting them to their next adventure. Home to the world’s largest outdoor community, with members and trails around the globe, you can find AllTrails in the Apple App Store, Google Play Store, and at alltrails.com. Every day, our team works to get more people outside and help our members have better experiences on the trail. We lead with our values–positivity, innovation, humility, adaptability, inclusivity, and stewardship–in everything we do. Join us! This is a U.S. based hybrid position based in our San Francisco headquarters. Candidates should be able to work from the office once per week, or more frequently as needed. Our office is located in San Francisco’s Financial District near Union Square and is easily accessible via BART. Please note that, at this time, we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. The salary range listed reflects the base pay range for this position across all U.S. locations where we are hiring. The final salary offered will be based on the candidate's experience and skills and will meet or exceed any location-specific minimum salary or exempt-status threshold required by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.description_text: 클로버추얼패션 (CLO Virtual Fashion)은 3D 의상 시뮬레이션 알고리즘을 기반으로, 컨셉부터 디자인, 제조, 마케팅, 피팅, 스타일링까지 의상과 관련된 모든 서비스를 제공합니다. 2009년 설립된 클로버추얼패션은 3D 의상 시뮬레이션 알고리즘에 대한 독보적인 기술력을 바탕으로, 디지털 패션의 새로운 생태계를 만들어 가고 있습니다. 의상 디자인 소프트웨어 CLO, Marvelous Designer, Jinny와 함께, CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 플랫폼으로 의상의 모든 여정에 관여하여 효율적이고 지속가능한 워크플로우를 구축하고 있습니다. 뿐만 아니라, 당사 솔루션을 통해 실제 의상과 디지털 의상이 서로 태그되어 CLO 시스템 내에서 기능할 수 있게끔 합니다. 글로벌 디지털 패션 시장을 주도하고 있는 클로버추얼패션은 현재 아시아, 북미, 유럽, 남미 등 전 세계 12개국에 총 16개의 오피스를 두고 있으며, 세계 각국의 수많은 고객사를 바탕으로 점점 확장해나가고 있습니다. [CLO의 소프트웨어] CLO:https://www.clo3d.com Marvelous Designer:https://www.marvelousdesigner.com Jinny:https://connect.clo-set.com/jinny [CLO의 플랫폼] CLO-SET:https://style.clo-set.com/aboutus CONNECT:https://connect.clo-set.com/ [전세계 디자이너의 일하는 방식을 바꿔놓은 회사 - EO] https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RG8LFEKg1D8 [클로버추얼패션 채용 홈페이지] https://www.clovirtualfashion-careers.com/ Position Overview 클로버추얼패션의 Finance & Accounting Chapter는 회사의 숫자가 정확하고 투명하게 기록되도록 하고, 이를 바탕으로 회사가 올바른 의사결정을 내리고 지속적으로 성장할 수 있도록 돕습니다. 회사의 다음 성장 단계를 준비하는 여러 프로젝트를 진행함에 있어, 실무의 멤버로 참여하며 재무 전반의 경험을 함께하실 Accounting Associate를 선발합니다. 금번 포지션은 법인카드 및 일반비용 관리, 국내 매출 대사, 자금 반제 처리 등의 실무를 주도하며 데이터의 정합성을 높입니다. 특히, AI 네이티브 환경에 맞추어 단순 반복 업무와 서류 작업을 자동화하고 재무 워크플로우의 생산성을 극대화하는 과정을 함께할 분을 찾습니다. jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description_text: FireMon delivers Network Security Policy Control for the Modern Enterprise. Most enterprises run firewalls from multiple vendors alongside cloud security groups and microsegmentation platforms, and no single console can say whether it all works together. We believe policy is the control plane for network security: it defines what the environment should do, and the infrastructure carries it out. FireMon gives security teams one place to see, govern, and prove that their policy is doing what they intend, across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments. As a Solutions Architect, you'll play a valuable role within the FireMon Customer Experience team, helping to assess business opportunities and support the development of strategies to address technical challenges. In this role, you'll work closely with security architects, infrastructure specialists, and engineering teams within customer organizations, gaining hands-on experience designing effective, results-driven solutions. You will support both Pre-Sale (Buyer's Journey) and Post-Sale (Customer Journey) phases, building your technical expertise and product knowledge along the way. With guidance from senior team members, you'll help empower customers to make informed decisions and achieve success in their projects.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Robotics Deployment
jobs.description_text: FieldAI is transforming how robots interact with the real world. We are building risk-aware, reliable, and field-ready AI systems that address the most complex challenges in robotics, unlocking the full potential of embodied intelligence. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-based architectures, and are charting a new course, with already-globally-deployed solutions delivering real-world results and rapidly improving models through real-field applications. We are looking for a Project Manager, Robotics Deployment to keep our field deployments on schedule and on plan. You will build and maintain the project plans for deploying Field AI systems — including drones, quadrupeds, and humanoids — at customer sites, coordinate the engineers and operations staff who execute them, and be the person who knows the status of every workstream at any moment. You'll interface directly with the customer and work alongside Field Application Engineers, hardware and software teams, and operations staff. This is a strong role for someone with a technical foundation who wants to grow into program ownership: you don't need to debug a robot yourself, but you do need to understand what broke, who fixes it, and what it does to the schedule. This role is based in Singapore with occasional international travel.

jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Researcher – Arlington, VA
jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

jobs.description_text: At the heart of Mirego’s growth, your role as a Business Development Manager for the Toronto area is essential to identifying and qualifying new opportunities. You will also contribute to managing and growing existing accounts, ensuring the successful delivery of ongoing projects and identifying additional opportunities.

jobs.title: Chargé(e) de projets agiles
jobs.description_text: Chez Mirego, nous croyons profondément en une approche itérative souple et collaborative de la création de produits numériques. Faire évoluer nos produits par petits pas, avec une rétroaction constante de l'équipe et de nos clients, c'est pour nous la façon la plus efficace de créer de la vraie valeur. En tant que chargé·e de projet Agile, tu es au cœur de cette dynamique. Tu accompagnes l’équipe tout au long de la réalisation des projets, identifies les obstacles en cours de route et veilles à l’amélioration continue de leur processus de travail. Tu sais motiver les équipes pour assurer la livraison des projets de manière optimale, tout en respectant le budget, le calendrier et la portée.

jobs.title: Développeur(euse) IA
jobs.description_text: En tant que personne dédiée au développement IA, tu contribues chaque jour à la création de solutions d'intelligence artificielle innovantes qui ont pour ambition de transformer concrètement la façon dont nos clients font des affaires. Tu fais le pont entre le développement logiciel et l'univers de l'IA, en concevant des systèmes agentiques, des pipelines RAG et des solutions exploitant les modèles les plus performants du marché. Ton enthousiasme pour l'IA et ta curiosité insatiable t'incitent à rester à l'avant-garde d'un écosystème en constante évolution. Ce n'est pas simplement livrer d'excellentes solutions IA qui t'apportent de la fierté, mais aussi le chemin parcouru pour y arriver. C'est pourquoi tu aspires constamment à collaborer avec les personnes les plus talentueuses, afin de progresser et d'évoluer collectivement.

jobs.title: Développeur(euse) logiciel Back-End / DevOps
jobs.description_text: Au sein de l'équipe de développement, tu prends part chaque jour à la création de produits numériques innovants qui ont pour ambition de changer le monde, quels que soient leur envergure ou leur domaine. Tu es spécialisé en développement back-end, mais ce qui te distingue, c'est ta maîtrise de l'écosystème DevOps. Tu ne te contentes pas d'écrire du code robuste et maintenable : tu conçois, déploies et opères l'infrastructure qui lui permet de vivre et de performer. Ton enthousiasme pour le développement te pousse naturellement à relever des défis stimulants et à rester à l'avant-garde des technologies. Ce n'est pas simplement livrer d'excellents produits et services qui t'apporte de la fierté, mais aussi le chemin parcouru pour y arriver. C'est pourquoi tu aspires constamment à t’entourer des personnes les plus talentueuses, afin de progresser et d'évoluer collectivement.
